dct_description_sm: The purpose of collecting the water quality data and noting community sea-ice observation is so that youth can participate in the process of environmental monitoring within their community. It allows the youth the opportunity to learn the science associated with the subject and the data collected can be studied and compared to reveal information.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> E. coli
Health sciences and contaminants -> Water quality
dct_title_s: Water quality data and ice observations recorded by youth in Nunavut
